reference_sql:
SELECT pr.promo_code, pr.discount_pct, pp.product_id
FROM promotion_products pp
JOIN promotions pr ON pr.promo_id = pp.promo_id
alternatives: SELECT promotions.promo_code, promotions.discount_pct, promotion_products.product_id FROM promotions JOIN promotion_products ON promotion_products.promo_id = promotions.promo_id
SELECT pr.promo_code, pr.discount_pct, pp.product_id FROM promotion_products pp, promotions pr WHERE pr.promo_id = pp.promo_id

other_way.sql: SELECT pr.promo_code, pr.discount_pct, pp.product_id FROM promotion_products pp, promotions pr WHERE pr.promo_id = pp.promo_id
other_way.tradeoff: The comma form with the match in WHERE gives the same rows, but the join is easier to miss when reading.

SELECT pr.promo_code, pr.discount_pct, pp.product_id FROM promotion_products pp, promotions pr
